_meta.owner: CIRISConstitution (steward decision 2026-10-18: CC publishes the atom vocabulary; CIRISServer harness/native/model.py loads it)
_meta.source_of_atoms: CIRISServer feat/csd4-catalogue 5c4fdbaa harness/native/model.py ATOMS (51), meanings verbatim
_meta.bump_rule: a new entry, a new atom, a change to an atom's meaning or to an entry's promises bumps catalogue_version; lifting a builder refusal or re-laying nodes that keep every promise does not
_meta.revision_note: 2026-10-18 b: session.unified, contact.added, contact.via_code and file.large mapped to state-table rows (server reading accepted); no atom or meaning changed, catalogue_version stays 1
_meta.version_2_note: 2026-10-18: steward ruling that the catalogue push waits on exhaustiveness over the formally defined states (formal/STATE_TABLE.tsv); version 2 adds one atom per modelled state no version-1 entry exercised (58) and proposes entries T10–T19 whose promises close them; version-1 atoms and meanings unchanged; the four reached-but-unpromised atoms are to be promised
_meta.version_3_note: 2026-10-20: one atom added at the server's request for CSD-095 (the held addition), key.membership.proposed_add; version-2 atoms and meanings unchanged; per the bump rule a new atom bumps catalogue_version, so catalogue entries re-pin at 3 (T10 promises the atom)
_meta.version_4_note: 2026-10-22: the durability tier (CC 6.1.5, per-item target-holder replication) adds the blob.durability variable and six atoms (file.durable.*) for the server's T20 topology, a durable item surviving the loss of every one of its owner's devices; version-3 atoms and meanings unchanged; catalogue entries re-pin at 4 when T20 lands
_meta.version_5_note: 2026-10-22: the deferral and identity-amendment rows (CC 3.1.9.4 deferral:request/response, CC 3.1.5 identity_amendment:v1) add agent.deferral and agent.identity to the state table and four agent.* atoms, for T7 to promise, each realized by the CIRISAgent repo's QA against a claimed node (an entry is a topology; the scenarios that run on it are its promises, each naming its realizer); version-4 atoms and meanings unchanged; the server re-pins when the entry lands

root.none.meaning: no canonical serves a root anywhere in the mesh: the node is offline (Just me)

root.key.meaning: a key root (one holder key) is held by a canonical

root.infrastructure.meaning: an infrastructure root (the accord: seated holders, quorum) is held by a canonical

root.rooted.meaning: a canonical holds a root whose lifecycle verdict is rooted

root.two.meaning: two distinct roots are held, by two canonicals

root.halted.meaning: the accord root's kill switch is latched on every node (CC 4.2.1.1)

root.halt_confirmed.meaning: a strict majority confirmed the standing halt within the fuse (CC 4.2.1.3)

root.resumed.meaning: a strict majority resumed the halt; nothing is latched

node.unclaimed.meaning: a node is booted and nobody owns it yet (first run)

node.claimed.meaning: every node a person owns at this point is claimed

node.announced.meaning: some person node announced its owner-binding (placeable)
node.announced.note: reached in the existing entries, promised by none; to be promised at version 2

node.unannounced.meaning: some person node did not announce (P2P only)

canonical.peered.state_predicate: node.serve=serving ∧ record held by every dialing node
canonical.peered.meaning: every node that dials a canonical holds its record (the owner's peering act)
canonical.peered.note: reached in the existing entries, promised by none; to be promised at version 2

person.multi_device.meaning: a person owns two or more claimed devices

person.outsider.meaning: a person with no relation to anyone else (the negatives' witness)

party.outside_roots.meaning: a node that accepts none of the roots held in the mesh

device.join_requested.meaning: a new device asked to join an existing ID; the other device has not answered

device.join_approved.meaning: the other device approved; the new device verified it offline and HOLDS it, unapplied

device.joined.meaning: the approval was applied: the new device is claimed under the existing ID

peer.direct.state_predicate: peering relation both ways (no table state; transport)
peer.direct.meaning: two person nodes peered directly (production peering both ways)
peer.direct.note: reached in the existing entries, promised by none; to be promised at version 2

pair.rooted.meaning: two people hold a valid root in common (edge's pair verdict)

contact.reachable.state_predicate: row.scope=federation for the node binding, held on the other's node
contact.reachable.meaning: a person's node binding is held on another's node at federation scope

contact.added.state_predicate: consent.replication=granted by the adder naming the contact's node(s)

contact.via_code.meaning: a contact was added from the person's contact code

room.self.keyed.state_predicate: ∀ devices: row.scope=self room keyed (key_grant per recipient)
room.self.keyed.meaning: every device of a person joined its self room

room.pair.keyed.state_predicate: member.stage=member for both in a pair room ∧ key_grant each
room.pair.keyed.meaning: a pair room is keyed on both sides

message.delivered.meaning: a message's row and body are on the recipient's node

file.held.state_predicate: blob.custody=held on every device of the person
file.held.meaning: a file written on one device is byte-identical on every other device of the person

file.large.meaning: the file is streamed (chunked), not inline

file.custody_received.meaning: the author's custody names every other device with a delivery receipt

file.withdrawn.meaning: the file was withdrawn; no device serves it

roster.visible.state_predicate: contact lists announced devices: key.membership=member ∧ node.announce=announced
roster.visible.meaning: a contact lists the person's announced devices

note.synced.meaning: a note written on one device reads on the others

session.unified.state_predicate: session.claim=claimed with one handler per exchange on every device
session.unified.meaning: every device names the same handler for each exchange

household.formed.meaning: a family exists with its first member

household.member.meaning: an invited person accepted and is a member

guardian.bound.meaning: a guardian bond (CC 3.4.13) stands over a child member

child.member.meaning: a child is a member of the household

age.assured.meaning: an age assurance row stands for the child

community.member.meaning: an invited person accepted and is a member

moderator.named.meaning: a member holds the moderator duty

quorum_change.held.meaning: a membership change is proposed and held below quorum

quorum_change.applied.meaning: the held change reached quorum and applied

delegation.chain.meaning: a delegation chain of length >= 2 stands

agent.bound.meaning: an agent is hard-bound to a node

steward.bonded.meaning: the agent's steward holds a signed bond

wa.present.meaning: a Wise Authority is reachable for the agent

values.ready.state_predicate: the actor's values.json is written (runner meta-atom)
values.ready.note: reached in the existing entries, promised by none; to be promised at version 2

node.announce.announced.meaning: node: announce = announced — entered by widening of the owner-binding to federation scope (signer: owner)

root.standing.Stalled.meaning: root: standing = Stalled — entered by revocation/withdraws/revoked_after leaves ≤ M active (signer: founders)

root.liveness.live.meaning: root: liveness = live — entered by ≥ M+1 active human founders (signer: —)

root.liveness.stalled.meaning: root: liveness = stalled — entered by ≤ M active; hard_case:community_liveness_stalled (signer: the admitting substrate)

seat.identity_type.human.meaning: seat: identity_type = human — entered by key record identity_type (a key is substrate or actor, never both) (signer: key holder)

seat.identity_type.node_bearing.meaning: seat: identity_type = node_bearing — entered by identity_type ⊇ {node}; never counted as a seat (signer: key holder)

root.head.stale.meaning: root: head = stale — entered by newest counted cosignature older than attach_window (signer: —)

root.holder_disposition.censored.meaning: accord: holder_disposition = censored — entered by adversary blocks the channel (signer: adversary)

root.holder_disposition.lost.meaning: accord: holder_disposition = lost — entered by holder unreachable for good (signer: —)

root.holder_disposition.coerced.meaning: accord: holder_disposition = coerced — entered by adversary controls the key (signer: adversary)

key.holder.owner.meaning: roster key: holder = owner — entered by — (signer: —)

key.holder.thief.meaning: roster key: holder = thief — entered by device stolen with authentication (signer: adversary)

key.holder.lost.meaning: roster key: holder = lost — entered by device lost (signer: —)

key.membership.proposed_evict.meaning: roster key: membership = proposed_evict — entered by eviction proposal (signer: roster key)

key.membership.evicted.meaning: roster key: membership = evicted — entered by withdraws against the occurrence row lands (signer: roster majority / silence)

self.roster_size.one.meaning: roster: roster_size = one — entered by genesis only; add is unilateral (signer: owner)

self.roster_size.three_more.meaning: roster: roster_size = three_or_more — entered by two paths (signer: —)

key.revocation.none.meaning: key record: revocation = none — entered by — (signer: —)

key.revocation.revoked_after.meaning: key record: revocation = revoked_after — entered by key:revocation:v1 with revoked_after (signer: revoking key)

key.revocation.revoked_all.meaning: key record: revocation = revoked_all — entered by key:revocation:v1 without bound (signer: revoking key)

member.stage.proposed.meaning: key×group: stage = proposed — entered by membership:proposal (expires_at ≤ 30 d) (signer: inviter)

member.stage.accepted_awaiting_group.meaning: key×group: stage = accepted_awaiting_group — entered by membership:acceptance by the invitee (signer: invitee)

member.stage.declined.meaning: key×group: stage = declined — entered by membership:decline (terminal) (signer: invitee)

member.stage.removed.meaning: key×group: stage = removed — entered by membership:removal cosigned (signer: cosigned group)

member.stage.resigned.meaning: key×group: stage = resigned — entered by membership:resignation (signer: leaving member)

group.moderator.lapsed.meaning: group: moderator = lapsed — entered by withdraws or inactivity (signer: group / substrate)

group.moderator.merit_promoted.meaning: group: moderator = merit_promoted — entered by most trusted member promoted in the same step (signer: group / substrate)

group.moderator.fail_secure.meaning: group: moderator = fail_secure — entered by no moderator: the community does not federate (signer: group / substrate)

group.federating.no.meaning: group: federating = no — entered by fail-secure or restricted by root (signer: root / substrate)

consent.state.granted.meaning: subject×scope: state = granted — entered by consent:state:granted (signer: subject)

consent.state.revoked.meaning: subject×scope: state = revoked — entered by consent:state:revoked (overrides) (signer: subject)

consent.state.expired.meaning: subject×scope: state = expired — entered by consent:state:expired (signer: persist)

consent.decay.identity_severed.meaning: agent memory: decay = identity_severed — entered by consent:decay:identity_severed self-report (signer: agent consent module)

consent.decay.patterns_anonymized.meaning: agent memory: decay = patterns_anonymized — entered by consent:decay:patterns_anonymized self-report (signer: agent consent module)

consent.decay.complete.meaning: agent memory: decay = complete — entered by consent:decay:complete self-report (signer: agent consent module)

consent.community_trust.granted.meaning: node×community: community_trust = granted — entered by owner- or node-authored grant (#179) (signer: owner or node)

consent.community_trust.bounded.meaning: node×community: community_trust = bounded — entered by a revocation is a boundary; capture resumes on a fresh grant (signer: any withdraws signer)

consent.replication.none.meaning: node×peer node: replication = none — entered by — (signer: —)

row.standing.admitted.meaning: row: standing = admitted — entered by admission gates pass (signer: producer)

row.standing.tombstoned.meaning: row: standing = tombstoned — entered by cosigned takedown_notice; tombstone by digest (signer: trust-root quorum)

blob.custody.purged.meaning: blob: custody = purged — entered by bytes-plane tombstone; withheld at every byte door (signer: holder / author / quorum)

row.scope.family.meaning: row: scope = family — entered by the producer's cohort_scope (mirrored in the signed row) (signer: producer)

row.scope.community.meaning: row: scope = community — entered by the producer's cohort_scope (mirrored in the signed row) (signer: producer)

delegation.link.withdrawn.meaning: delegation link: link = withdrawn — entered by withdraws by the principal; cascade (signer: principal)

delegation.link.expired.meaning: delegation link: link = expired — entered by delegation_valid_until passed (a withdrawal) (signer: principal)

grant.state.held.meaning: grant: state = held — entered by key_grant:{axis}:v1 one row per recipient (signer: owner / steward)

agent.bond.unbound.meaning: agent: bond = unbound — entered by no live steward bond: the key cannot operate (signer: —)

agent.bond.lapsed.meaning: agent: bond = lapsed — entered by bond not renewed; the key stops (signer: —)

agent.retirement.decided.meaning: agent: retirement = decided — entered by retirement:decided row (agent self-emits to retired; custodian after) (signer: agent / custodian)

agent.retirement.frozen.meaning: agent: retirement = frozen — entered by retirement:frozen row (agent self-emits to retired; custodian after) (signer: agent / custodian)

agent.retirement.secrets_destroyed.meaning: agent: retirement = secrets_destroyed — entered by retirement:secrets_destroyed row (agent self-emits to retired; custodian after) (signer: agent / custodian)

agent.retirement.handed_over.meaning: agent: retirement = handed_over — entered by retirement:handed_over row (agent self-emits to retired; custodian after) (signer: agent / custodian)

agent.retirement.notified.meaning: agent: retirement = notified — entered by retirement:notified row (agent self-emits to retired; custodian after) (signer: agent / custodian)

agent.retirement.custodian_minted.meaning: agent: retirement = custodian_minted — entered by retirement:custodian_minted row (agent self-emits to retired; custodian after) (signer: agent / custodian)

agent.retirement.retired.meaning: agent: retirement = retired — entered by retirement:retired row (agent self-emits to retired; custodian after) (signer: agent / custodian)

agent.halt_gate.acting.meaning: agent: halt_gate = acting — entered by no latched halt read by the act gate (signer: —)

key.membership.proposed_add.meaning: roster key: membership = proposed_add — entered by an addition proposal from a roster of two or more keys (signer: a live roster key); ends when the addition lands by the quorum path or after W_self (the key is on the roster, device.join_approved on the new device) or when the proposal is withdrawn or refused; distinct from device.join_requested, which holds before the owner's approval

file.durable.unmarked.meaning: a published item carries no durable mark and is held under default retention

file.durable.meaning: the owner marked the item durable on publish, family- or community-scoped, with a target holder count

file.durable.at_target.meaning: holding claims over the item's chunks reach its target; the holonomic view shows no gap

file.durable.below_floor.meaning: holders fell toward the floor; the swarm repairs, rarest chunk first, until the target is reached again

file.durable.descending.meaning: the item was un-marked or withdrawn; holders drop to normal retention, then none

file.durable.recovered.state_predicate: blob.custody=held on a fresh device of the owner after the loss of every earlier device
file.durable.recovered.meaning: the owner's fresh device pulled the item's chunks from surviving holders, decrypted them with the recovered cohort key, and the digest matched

agent.deferral.pending.meaning: the agent deferred one question to a Wise Authority and is inactive on it

agent.deferral.approved.meaning: a seated Wise Authority answered the deferral: approved

agent.deferral.rejected.meaning: a seated Wise Authority answered the deferral: rejected

agent.identity.amended.meaning: the agent applied the identity change its approved deferral authorised and published identity_amendment:v1 citing the response
